lines: Damn it. Tokiko. Why didn't she wake me up?!
I had overslept and was now running full speed toward Gosha Academy.
Normally, I didn't mind being late, or hell, even skipping class.
But Tokiko, who wanted to change my halcyon lifestyle no matter what, had told me that I wouldn't get dinner the next time it happened.
So that's why! That's why she left me alone and went out! Tokikooo!
I was running as fast as possible, having already missed out on breakfast.
Looking at my watch I saw that it was almost time and the first bell would ring soon.
If I kept running like this, I would be right on the edge of somehow making it in time.
All right, I just had to turn at that corner and the rest would be a straight shotー
Uwaaah... I'm late, I'm late, I'm late...!!
Just as I was about to turn the corner, a girl suddenly appeared after jumping over the fence on the side of the road.
The girl came falling toward me.
It was a damn surprise attack. There had been no way to avoid it.
We collided spectacularly and both fell onto our butts with a thud.
Owowowow... Hey! I told you to move. Why didn't you?!
Apparently she was more athletic than I was; she immediately stood up and lashed out at me.
For some reason I could also hear an annoying sparking sound.
Oh, it's you, Fuma. You can't even avoid something like that? The captain of the Independent Commando Unit really is pathetic, huh.
I looked up at the source of the sarcastic words and saw a familiar, suntanned Taimanin.
Oh, it's you. Who could avoid that when you come flying out of nowhere?
Mizuki Yukikaze. A girl who was considered the upcoming ace Taimanin.
She was a Lightning Art user, so she could control powerful lightning strikes that put Shikanosuke's Electric Art to shame.
But she was too flashy during missions, and she had destroyed countless objects and facilities in the process.
There were issues with her personality and her chest, but at least the face of the "Lightning Taimanin" was extraordinarily cute.
What do you mean by, "Oh, it's you"? There's no reason for you to address me like that.
Same here. I don't recall saying you say "you" like that to me either.
I wondered what fate had in store for me, bumping into a girl on the way to school, but it turned out like this...
Upon hearing me grumble, Yukikaze charged her body with electricity, and she glared at me while crackling noisily.
I didn't say anything. Don't pick a fight with me first thing in the morning. It's annoying.
What?! You're the one trying to pick a fightー
The bell rang heartlessly. I had forgotten that I was on the verge of being late.
We looked at each other and made a dash for the main gate.
There was already gate attendants from the student council waiting at the main gate, ready to ticket anyone who was late.
Yukikaze and I were peeking from the shadows.
This is all because you were dawdling back there, Fuma.
Hey, how is this my fault?
So you're saying that it's my fault?
If you hadn't suddenly jumped out like that...
And just when we were about to start arguing again...
Two voices called out to me from another shadow.
And what do you know, it was Shikanosuke and Hebiko. They were carefully sneaking closer to me, so as not to be seen by the gate attendants.
I stayed up a little bit too late.
Ehehe, Hebiko too. What about you, Fuma-chan?
Something like that. And there's one more of us.
What's this now?! Do Fuma-chan and Yukikaze-chan walk to school together?
It seemed like Hebiko had had her curiosity piqued and she asked with a twinkle in her eye.
We just happened to meet on the way. Or more like we bumped into each other on the way. But now we're in a pinch with the gate attendants standing there.
Yea, Hebiko and Shikanosuke-chan are also in a pinch because of that. Fuma-chan, what's the plan?
Let's see. I guess we'll have to sneak in through the woods behind the school building.
Can a crowd of four make it okay?
Well, I guess let's split into groups... No, that might actually make it more difficult...
Even though it was the forest behind the school building, this was still Gosha Academy. There was no way it would be unguarded.
There would be ten or twenty layers of security in place.
And just when I was trying to figure out a way to sneak in...
Why do we have to go through all that trouble? I hid with you without thinking about it, but why don't we just break through the main entrance?
Yukikaze popped out of the shadows.
It should be a piece of cake♪
I tried to stop her, but...
Hey, I see you hiding over there!
There's even four of them! You're all late. Come out and take your tickets!
